# `{upxdvir}` Demo

## Libraries

```{r imports, message = FALSE}
library(grid)
library(upxdvir)
```

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
source("demo-helpers.R")
setKnitrPresets(4, 4)
```

## Examples

### Vertical Typesetting

```{r vert}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The text is rendered vertically by default.",
    y = .8,
    direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", gp = gpar(height = 1))
```

### Horizontal Typesetting

```{r horiz}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex(
    "The \\texttt{direction = 0} parameter typesets text horizontally.",
    gp = gpar(width = unit(2, "in")),
    y = .75, direction = 0
)
grid.uplatex("「JRまで 0.5 km」と聞いた。", direction = 0)
```

## Regression Checks

```{r reg}
drawGrid()
grid.latex("LuaTeX", engine = "LuaTeX", y = .7)
grid.latex("XeTeX", engine = "XeTeX", y = .3)
```
